headline: This is Cortexplor
dek: Artificial intelligence news, explained in plain language.

ui.confirm: AI news every day, on the site and here

s2.label: What it is
s2.title: A news site only about AI
body: Cortexplor covers model launches, market moves, regulation and how companies use AI, from Brazil and around the world.
Every story explains what happened and why it matters, without jargon and without hype.

s3.label: How it works
s3.title: No fact goes in unconfirmed
s3.body: Every story goes through the same process before it is published.

points.t: Recent news from established journalism sources.
A fact only goes in when two independent sources confirm it.
Original text, with the sources listed at the end of the story.

s4.label: Why it matters
s4.title: Information checked before publishing
body: AI moves fast, and much of what circulates is announcement, rumor or exaggeration.
When sources disagree on a detail, the story says so instead of hiding it.

items.t: Summaries of the top AI news, to understand it without leaving Instagram.
Full stories in Portuguese, English and Spanish, with their sources.
A WhatsApp group and a Telegram channel, coming soon.

caption.hook: Cortexplor is a news site about artificial intelligence, now on Instagram in English too.
body: Here you'll find model launches, market moves, regulation and how companies use AI, from Brazil and around the world. Every story is explained in plain language: what happened, how it works and why it matters.
The method is the same for every story. A fact only goes in when two independent sources confirm it, and the sources are listed at the end of each story.
On this profile, carousels sum up the top AI news. The site has the full stories in Portuguese, English and Spanish.
caption.cta: Which AI topic deserves more attention here?
